optics.frustum.summary: Build a rectangular pyramidal frustum from an optical pupil/datum, full HFOV/VFOV, roll and near/far ranges, and clip it against a declared window whose edge limits the cone.

inputs.pupil: Object {origin, direction, up?}: optical pupil/datum; direction is the optical axis, up sets roll (horizontal axis).
inputs.fov: Object {horizontal, vertical} full HFOV/VFOV angle expressions.
inputs.ranges: Object {near, far} clip distances along the optical axis; 0 < near < far.
inputs.window: Optional {distance, width, height} rectangular aperture centered on the axis; an edge smaller than the FOV cross-section limits the cone.

limitations: The frustum is a rectangular pyramid; it is not a lens prescription and no focus, flare or image-quality property is computed. Roll beyond the declared up vector is not inferred.

optics.coverage.summary: Compute the geometric union of several sensor frusta over a planar target and report dead zones and near-field gaps; FOV angle sums are not treated as no-dead-zone evidence.

inputs.sensors: Nonempty array of {name?, pupil:{origin,direction,up?}, fov:{horizontal,vertical}, ranges:{near?,far?}}.
inputs.targets: Nonempty array of {name?, origin, normal, u, outline:[[x,y],...]}; outline is a polygon in the target plane (basis u, v = normal x u).
inputs.samplingBudget: Positive integer grid budget for union-area estimation, default 100000.

limitations: Coverage is a deterministic grid estimate of the geometric union, not an exact analytic union and not a photometric/MTF result. A surface that is transparent in a render has no physical optical property unless a transparency policy declares it.

optics.occlusion.summary: Trace rays from a pupil against opaque obstacles, transparent windows (only when a transparency policy declares them) and line-of-sight baffles.

inputs.rays: Nonempty array of {direction:[unit]} (infinite ray) or {target:[x,y,z]} (ray to a point) descriptors.
inputs.obstacles: Array of {name?, kind:opaque|baffle|window, shape:{type:box|disk|polygon,...}, transmittance?}; window without transmittance is opaque unless policy.transparentByDefault.
inputs.policy: Object {transparentByDefault?:false}: a render-transparent surface has no physical optical property unless declared.

limitations: Line-of-sight is geometric ray casting; it is not a flare/stray-light simulation and makes no focus or imaging claim. Transparent windows pass rays only when their transparency is explicitly declared.

sensor.alignment-check.summary: Compare a sensor axis to a reference axis with gap/offset/angle limits and forbidden-material zones; a geometric axis, never a magnetic-field claim.

inputs.sensor: Object {name?, origin, axis}: sensor position and optical/mechanical axis.
inputs.reference: Object {name?, origin, axis}: reference axis (a magnet axis is a geometric axis, not a field claim).
inputs.limits: Object {angle, offset, gap?:{min?,max?}}: angle and offset limits plus optional axial gap bounds.
inputs.forbiddenZones: Array of {name?, type:box, min, max} forbidden-material zones the sensor axis must not enter.

limitations: Alignment is a geometric axis comparison; no magnetic-field, RF or electrical property is computed or claimed.
